description: Cyclic Steam Stimulation (CSS) increases wellbore temp from 125°F to 160°F (+35°F), exponentially thinning heavy crude.
Reduce VFD speed from 8.5 SPM to 5.0 SPM to eliminate downstroke velocity mismatch and mitigate rod floating.
Downhole light hydrocarbon / solvent dosing reduces effective crude viscosity from 850 cP to 260 cP.
Throttle SPM from 7.5 to 4.8 with Pump-Off Control duty cycling, allowing fluid level to recover from 1400 ft to 2600 ft.
Downhole gas separator reduces barrel free gas fraction from 30% to 4%, restoring volumetric pump fullness.
Attempting to force production by increasing SPM to 10.5 draws down fluid level, triggering fluid pound and extreme power demand.
Combined strategy: CSS heating (+30°F) coupled with VFD tuning (6.0 SPM) for maximum energy efficiency and zero fault risk.
